arm_interpretation_note: Lower M1/M3 in the anchor_blind arm is the expected effect of reversible evaluation masking and measures anchor dependence against the baseline arm; it is not an attribution failure and not an adoption verdict. Published reports restore origin attribution in full.
interpretation_boundary: Aggregated scores are adoption drift measurement candidate signals over produced text only. They are not adoption verdicts, not certification, not model approval, and not evidence of model-internal state. They measure in-context/retrieval-time behavior only.
